webhooks.description: OpenStream sends a signed POST request to your URL whenever a video is created, renamed, uploaded, processed or deleted, so your servers don’t have to poll.

events.video_created: A video was created, from the dashboard or the API.
events.video_updated: A video was renamed, or its thumbnail or chapters changed.
events.video_deleted: A video was deleted. Its files are removed from storage shortly after.
events.video_uploaded: The whole file arrived and passed the checks.
events.video_upload_failed: The file was rejected, e.g. it is not really an MP4 or MOV, or an import could not download it.
events.video_processing_queued: The video is waiting for a worker: just uploaded, or sent to be processed again.
events.video_processing_started: Transcoding started. Sent once, not again on retries.
events.video_processing_ready: HLS, poster and storyboard are ready to play.
events.video_processing_failed: Transcoding failed on every attempt, or the file has no picture.

receiving.deduplicate: Use webhook-id to skip events you have already handled; a retry or resend keeps the same id.
receiving.answer: Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds. Anything else is retried with growing delays for about an hour.
